# ng-dijta (@ngdx/dijta) — Consumer Guide

> Angular 18.1 + Angular Material 18.1 shared UI component library that exposes 100+ exports across components, directives, pipes, services, and animations — `dx-*` wrappers for forms, inputs, tables, tiles, charts, layouts, pickers, modals, and more — plus a Material-based theme system with `--dx-*` design tokens, CASL permission integration, and Transloco-based i18n. This file briefs AI agents working in **consuming applications** on how to install, configure, import, theme, and translate the library — and the rules they must follow when writing code that uses it.

> **Where this file lives:** it ships inside the npm package at `node_modules/@ngdx/dijta/llms.txt`. Every reference below is reachable from inside that package — you don't need access to the ng-dijta source repository.

## What ng-dijta Is (and Isn't)

- **Is:** an Angular 18 NgModule-based component library, published as `@ngdx/dijta`, shipped via ng-packagr. Material-first — every `dx-*` component wraps an Angular Material primitive (or uses Angular CDK) and respects the active Material theme. Most components are `NgModule`-based; a small subset is standalone.
- **Isn't:** standalone-by-default, signal-only, framework-agnostic, or backend-coupled. It does not bundle translation dictionaries or icon sets — consumers supply those.

## Installation & Peer Dependencies

The library is published to a private registry (`https://repository.serole.com/repository/dx-npm-hosted/`). Install with `npm install @ngdx/dijta` once that registry is configured (typically via `.npmrc`).

`@ngdx/dijta` declares these as peer dependencies — consuming apps MUST install compatible versions:

```
@angular/common ^18.1, @angular/core ^18.1, @angular/material ^18.1,
@angular/material-moment-adapter ^18.1, @jsverse/transloco ^7.4.2,
@casl/ability ^6.5, @casl/angular ^8.2.1,
moment ^2.30, moment-timezone ^0.5.39,
echarts ^5.4, ngx-echarts ^18.0,
lodash ^4.17, libphonenumber-js ^1.11, inputmask ^5.0, @ngneat/input-mask 6.1.0, ngx-mask 19.0.6,
dompurify ^3.2, cropperjs ^1.6, mobx ^6.13, fp-ts ^1.13,
resize-observer-polyfill ^1.5, tui-calendar ^1.15, ts-input-mask ^2.1,
mrmime ^2.0, bootstrap ^5.3, @types/core-js ^2.5
```

Install only the peers the components you actually use require — for example, `echarts` + `ngx-echarts` are only needed when you import `DxChartModule` / `DxChartTileModule`.

## Theme Setup (MANDATORY)

The library ships a bundled SCSS theme at `dist/ng-dijta/theme/_dx-theme.scss` (generated by `scss-bundle`). Consumers must:

1. Configure a Material theme using `@angular/material` theming APIs (or use a prebuilt theme like `deeppurple-amber.css`).
2. Import the ng-dijta theme partial in your global `styles.scss`:

   ```scss
   @use '@angular/material' as mat;
   @import '@angular/material/prebuilt-themes/deeppurple-amber.css';
   @import '@ngdx/dijta/theme/dx-theme';
   ```

3. Provide Angular animations in your app bootstrap (`provideAnimationsAsync()` or `BrowserAnimationsModule`) — Material components require it.

The library defines `--dx-*` CSS custom properties (design tokens). Override them at the `:root` level to retheme without ejecting; never override Material private APIs and never set hardcoded colors on `dx-*` selectors from consuming code.

### MD3-aligned aliases

The library exposes MD3-style aliases that resolve through its existing role tokens. Either name works in consumer code; both names always resolve to the same value, including under brand overrides:

| MD3 alias | Resolves through | Default |
|-----------|------------------|---------|
| `--dx-primary` | `--primary-base` | `#CC0000` |
| `--dx-on-primary` | `--primary-on-base` | `#FFFFFF` |
| `--dx-surface` | `--surface-base` | `#FFFFFF` |
| `--dx-on-surface` | `--surface-on-base` | `#2F2F2F` |
| `--dx-surface-card` | `--surface-base` | `#FFFFFF` (deprecation planned — prefer `--dx-surface` or `--dx-card-background` in new code) |
| `--dx-surface-variant` | `--surface-light` | `#F3F7FF` |
| `--dx-on-surface-variant` | `--color-text-secondary` | `#667085` |
| `--dx-error` | `--error-fc` | `#bd3232` |

To retheme, override **either** name at `:root` in your app's `styles.scss` — overriding the legacy name automatically flows through to the alias.

```scss
:root {
  /* Brand override — both --primary-base and --dx-primary become #1976d2 */
  --primary-base: #1976d2;
}
```

Additional MD3 tokens (`--dx-on-error`, `--dx-error-container`, `--dx-outline`, `--dx-focus-ring`, `--dx-primary-container`, `--dx-secondary-container`) are not yet exposed by the library. Until they ship in a future release, declare them at `:root` in your own app's `styles.scss` if you need them — the library will not override your declarations when it adopts them later.

### Spacing scale

The library ships a canonical 5-step spacing scale. Use these tokens for padding / margin / gap instead of raw `rem` / `px` values.

| Token | Default | Pixels | Typical use |
|-------|---------|--------|-------------|
| `--dx-spacing-xs` | `0.25rem` |  4px | Icon-to-text gap, tight inline spacing |
| `--dx-spacing-sm` | `0.5rem`  |  8px | Compact form rows, chip padding |
| `--dx-spacing-md` | `1rem`    | 16px | Default block padding, card content |
| `--dx-spacing-lg` | `1.5rem`  | 24px | Section gaps, dialog padding |
| `--dx-spacing-xl` | `2rem`    | 32px | Page-level vertical rhythm |

### Radius scale

| Token | Default | Pixels | Typical use |
|-------|---------|--------|-------------|
| `--dx-radius-sm` | `0.25rem` |  4px | Chips, small inputs |
| `--dx-radius-md` | `0.5rem`  |  8px | Cards, buttons (default) |
| `--dx-radius-lg` | `1rem`    | 16px | Modals, large surfaces |

Both scales are overridable at `:root` like the colour aliases — declare the same name in your app's `styles.scss` to shift the scale globally.

## Import Rules (STRICT)

```typescript
// CORRECT — always import from the package barrel
import {
  DxButtonModule,
  DxInputModule,
  DxTableModule,
  DxLayoutModule,
  // ...
} from '@ngdx/dijta';
```

```typescript
// FORBIDDEN — deep paths into the library's internals
import { DxButtonModule } from '@ngdx/dijta/lib/components/dx-button/dx-button.module';
import { DxInputComponent } from '@ngdx/dijta/lib/components/dx-input/dx-input.component';
```

Deep imports break tree-shaking, bypass the public-API contract, and will break on minor releases. Always go through the `@ngdx/dijta` barrel — the package's `./index.d.ts` (i.e. `node_modules/@ngdx/dijta/index.d.ts`) is the canonical list of what's importable. Grep it before assuming a symbol is available.

## Using a Component (NgModule Pattern)

Most `dx-*` components are NgModule-based. To use one:

1. Import its `DxXxxModule` from `@ngdx/dijta` into the consuming `NgModule.imports` array (or `Component.imports` if the consuming component is standalone).
2. Use the component's selector in your template.

```typescript
import { NgModule } from '@angular/core';
import { BrowserAnimationsModule } from '@angular/platform-browser/animations';
import {
  DxButtonModule,
  DxInputModule,
  DxLayoutModule,
  DxHeaderModule,
  DxTableModule,
} from '@ngdx/dijta';

@NgModule({
  imports: [
    BrowserAnimationsModule,
    DxLayoutModule,
    DxHeaderModule,
    DxButtonModule,
    DxInputModule,
    DxTableModule,
    // ...
  ],
})
export class AppModule {}
```

```html
<dx-layout>
  <dx-header [title]="'dx.app.title' | transloco"></dx-header>
  <dx-input [label]="'Name'" [(value)]="name"></dx-input>
  <dx-button label="Save" (click)="save()"></dx-button>
</dx-layout>
```

## i18n Setup (MANDATORY)

ng-dijta emits Transloco translation keys with the `dx.` prefix (e.g., `dx.button.save`, `dx.aria.close`). The library does NOT bundle translation dictionaries — consumers must:

1. Configure `@jsverse/transloco` `^7.4.2` (matches the library's peer range; tested on 7.5) in the app — a `TranslocoRootModule` with `TRANSLOCO_LOADER`, `TRANSLOCO_CONFIG`, etc.
2. Ship `assets/i18n/{lang}.json` dictionaries containing the `dx.*` keys for every component used (plus app-specific keys).
3. Provide the `TranslocoModule` to any feature module that renders `dx-*` components.

The library uses Transloco 7.x APIs — use `translate()` and `selectTranslate()`, NOT the v8-only `translateSignal()`.

## CASL Permissions (Optional)

Some components (e.g., `dx-button`) integrate with `@casl/angular`'s `AbilityModule` for visibility/permission control. If the consuming app sets up CASL with `Ability` / `PureAbility` providers, those components will honour the ability rules automatically. If permissions aren't used, the components still render normally.

## Global Configuration

The library exposes `DxGlobalConfigService` (from `@ngdx/dijta`) for app-wide configuration such as the default table page size, org/user metadata, date format, currency, and timezone. Inject it where needed and call its public methods/signals to drive defaults across `dx-*` components.

```typescript
import { DxGlobalConfigService } from '@ngdx/dijta';
private readonly globalConfig = inject(DxGlobalConfigService);
```

## Component Inventory

Full inventory in `node_modules/@ngdx/dijta/index.d.ts` (and the matching `public-api.d.ts`). Grouped by purpose:

- **Layout & chrome:** `DxLayoutModule`, `DxHeaderModule`, `DxFooterModule`, `DxSidebarModule`, `DxNavigationMenuModule`, `DxDrawerModule`, `DxPageModule`, `DxPageContentMenuModule`, `DxBreadcrumbModule`, `DxStickyModule`, `DxFullscreenModule`, `DxSectionTitleModule`, `DxContentModule`
- **Buttons & actions:** `DxButtonModule`, `DxFloaterButtonModule`, `DxToggleModule`, `DxRadioButtonModule`, `DxCheckboxModule`
- **Inputs (text & validated):** `DxInputModule`, `DxTextareaModule`, `DxInputEmailModule`, `DxInputNameModule`, `DxInputDOBModule`, `DxInputDatePickerModule`, `DxInputCompanyModule`, `DxInputLabelModule`, `DxInputIconModule`, `DxInputPhoneModule`, `DxInputUrlModule`, `DxInputChipsModule`, `DxEmailModule`, `DxIpModule`
- **Numeric & formatted:** `DxNumberModule`, `DxCurrencyModule`, `LocalizedNumberPipe`, `LocalizedNumberFormatDirective`
- **Date / time:** `DxDatepickerModule`, `DxDaterangeModule`, `DxDatetimePickerModule`, `DxTimepickerModule`, `DxActivityCalendarModule`
- **Selection & lookup:** `DxSelectModule`, `DxAutocompleteSelectModule`, `DxChipSelectModule`, `DxChipAutocompleteModule`, `DxServerSideAutocompleteModule`, `DxTagInputModule`, `DxDualListboxModule`, `DxLookupModule` (`dx-multi-lookup`), `DxColorsModule` (`dx-color-picker`)
- **Tables & data:** `DxTableModule`, `DxConfigTableModule`, `DxTableViewWrapperModule`, `DxNestedTableModule`, `DxTableFilterModule`, `DxCriteriaFilterModule`, `DxAdvanceFilterModule`, `FlexTableModule`
- **Cards, tiles, status:** `DxCardModule`, `DxBasicTileModule`, `DxChartTileModule`, `DxTagModule`, `DxStatusModule`, `DxAvatarModule`, `DxEmptyModule`
- **Feedback & overlays:** `DxAlertMessageModule`, `DxNotificationModule`, `DxToastrModule` / `ToastrModule`, `DxPopupModule`, `DxPopoverModule`, `DxTooltipModule`, `DxConfirmModule`, `DxLoaderModule`, `DxSkeletonLoaderModule`
- **Files & media:** `DxFileUploadModule`, `DxImageUploadModule`, `DxIconSelectionPopupModule`, `DxQrcodeModule`, `DxCanvasModule`
- **Visualization:** `DxChartModule` (echarts), `DxKanbanViewModule`, `DxCoordinatesModule`, `DxTimelineModule`, `DxWidgetModule`
- **Navigation extras:** `DxTabGroupModule`, `DxTreeModule`, `DxTogglePanelModule`
- **Pipes & directives:** `LocalizedNumberPipe`, `NumberSuffixPipe`, `LocalizedNumberFormatDirective`, `LabelDirective`, `TrimInputDirective`
- **Services & utilities:** `DxGlobalConfigService`, `DxDijtaGlobalConfig`, `PermissionService`, `WindowRef`, plus utility helpers exported from `@ngdx/dijta`

When in doubt: the **only authoritative list** is `node_modules/@ngdx/dijta/index.d.ts`. Grep it before assuming a symbol is available.

## Rules for Code That Uses ng-dijta

When writing code in a consuming app, AI agents MUST:

1. **Material-first** — Never reinvent a Material primitive (dialog, menu, snackbar, tooltip, tabs, datepicker, autocomplete, table, etc.). Use Angular Material directly, or a `dx-*` wrapper if one exists in the package's `index.d.ts`.
2. **Prefer existing `dx-*` over building anything new.** Grep `node_modules/@ngdx/dijta/index.d.ts`. Build custom only when neither Material nor `dx-*` covers the need.
3. **Never deep-import.** Always `@ngdx/dijta`. Never `@ngdx/dijta/lib/...`.
4. **Never hardcode colors** on `dx-*` selectors. Use Material theme tokens or override `--dx-*` design tokens. No hex/rgb/hsl in SCSS targeting `dx-*` classes.
5. **All user-facing strings go through Transloco** — including ARIA labels passed to `dx-*` inputs. Use the `dx.{domain}.{context}.{description}` key pattern when extending the library's namespace; use your app's own namespace (e.g., `app.*`) for purely app strings.
6. **Trust Material's built-in accessibility** — don't add custom keyboard handlers or override ARIA on Material/`dx-*` components.
7. **Don't mix decorator and signal APIs in the same class.** ng-dijta components themselves are decorator-based; consuming code may use either flavour internally, but each class must pick one.
8. **`ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush`** on new consumer components — `dx-*` components are OnPush and assume immutable inputs.
9. **`@for` with a unique `track`** (or `*ngFor` with `trackBy`) when rendering lists of `dx-*` components.
10. **Use `takeUntilDestroyed()`** for any RxJS subscriptions in consuming components.

The ten rules above are a self-contained summary intended to be sufficient for consumer code. The library's full rule set (Tier-1 / Tier-2 / Tier-3 files covering prohibited patterns, security, accessibility, Angular 18, Material, i18n, performance, theming, style guide, testing, JSDoc) lives in the ng-dijta source repository and is not shipped to consumers — use this summary as the operative reference when writing code that uses `@ngdx/dijta`.

## Minimal End-to-End Example

```typescript
// app.module.ts
import { NgModule } from '@angular/core';
import { BrowserModule } from '@angular/platform-browser';
import { provideAnimationsAsync } from '@angular/platform-browser/animations/async';
import { provideHttpClient } from '@angular/common/http';

import {
  DxLayoutModule,
  DxHeaderModule,
  DxButtonModule,
  DxInputModule,
  DxTableModule,
  DxNotificationModule,
} from '@ngdx/dijta';

import { TranslocoRootModule } from './transloco-root.module';
import { AppComponent } from './app.component';

@NgModule({
  declarations: [AppComponent],
  imports: [
    BrowserModule,
    TranslocoRootModule,
    DxLayoutModule,
    DxHeaderModule,
    DxButtonModule,
    DxInputModule,
    DxTableModule,
    DxNotificationModule,
  ],
  providers: [provideAnimationsAsync(), provideHttpClient()],
  bootstrap: [AppComponent],
})
export class AppModule {}
```

```scss
/* styles.scss */
@use '@angular/material' as mat;
@import '@angular/material/prebuilt-themes/deeppurple-amber.css';
@import '@ngdx/dijta/theme/dx-theme';

:root {
  /* Optional: override --dx-* design tokens here */
}
```

```html
<!-- app.component.html -->
<dx-layout>
  <dx-header [title]="'app.title' | transloco"></dx-header>

  <dx-input
    [label]="'app.form.name' | transloco"
    [(value)]="name"
  ></dx-input>

  <dx-button
    [label]="'dx.button.save' | transloco"
    (click)="save()"
  ></dx-button>
</dx-layout>
```

## Verification Checklist for Consumer Code

Before submitting code that uses `@ngdx/dijta`:

- [ ] All imports come from `@ngdx/dijta` (no deep paths)
- [ ] Required `DxXxxModule` is in the host `NgModule.imports` (or standalone component `imports`)
- [ ] Animations are provided (`provideAnimationsAsync()` or `BrowserAnimationsModule`)
- [ ] Material theme + `@ngdx/dijta/theme/dx-theme` imported in `styles.scss`
- [ ] No hardcoded colors targeting `dx-*` classes
- [ ] When overriding tokens at `:root`, either the legacy name (e.g. `--primary-base`) or the MD3 alias (e.g. `--dx-primary`) is acceptable — both resolve to the same value
- [ ] All user-facing strings (including ARIA labels) go through Transloco
- [ ] Translation dictionaries contain every `dx.*` key the rendered components reference
- [ ] No custom reimplementations of Material/`dx-*` primitives
- [ ] Icon-only buttons have explicit `aria-label`
- [ ] Lists of `dx-*` components use `@for ... track` or `*ngFor ... trackBy`

## Reference Files Inside the Installed Package

Everything below is reachable at `node_modules/@ngdx/dijta/...` once the package is installed. No access to the ng-dijta source repository is required.

| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `index.d.ts` | Authoritative list of every exported symbol (modules, components, services, pipes, directives) — grep this to confirm what's importable from the `@ngdx/dijta` barrel |
| `public-api.d.ts` | Same contents as `index.d.ts`; both are emitted by ng-packagr |
| `theme/_dx-theme.scss` | The bundled SCSS theme (imported in consumer apps as `@ngdx/dijta/theme/dx-theme`) — defines every `--dx-*` design token and Material override |
| `package.json` | The library's `peerDependencies` block is the authoritative version-pinning truth |
| `README.md` | Top-level package overview |
| `lib/` | Compiled `.d.ts` files per component / service — useful when you need a specific symbol's type surface |
| `llms.txt` | This file |
